recommendation_text: Align proposal responses directly to evaluation factors and award basis.
Prepare evidence for past performance, eligibility, and socioeconomic requirements.
Review FAR/DOSAR and compliance obligations before bid decision.
Validate logistics assumptions and delivery-cost exposure.
Review pricing structure and contract type before estimating margin.
Map technical requirements into a response compliance matrix.
Track amendments, proposal instructions, and submission requirements.
Account for operational context such as installations, domain operations, or agency-specific requirements.
